name: Neon
oneLiner: Electric glow pairings and high-contrast color that demand attention and lose it deliberately.

notes: Glow is drawn outside the glyphs, so it adds no contrast: keep the accent text itself at the accent role and verify any pair you add.
The light scheme is a daylight variant, not a second identity — keep the accent hue, drop the glow.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-sm); background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(187, 243, 81, 0.35)

ghost.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(187, 243, 81, 0.35); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-accent)

default.base: padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(187, 243, 81, 0.18); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-md); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(187, 243, 81, 0.35); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-full); color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase
height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(187, 243, 81, 0.25); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-sm); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: var(--uiux-color-text)
default.focusVisible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(187, 243, 81, 0.18); outline: none

default.base: font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(187, 243, 81, 0.45)

do: Keep the page near-black and let the accent do all the glowing — one hue, one job.
Reserve glow for action, focus, and live status; a glow on static text means nothing.
Set labels small, uppercase, and widely tracked; set numbers large and monospaced.
dont: Do not glow more than two elements in one viewport.
Do not place the accent on large fills; it belongs to strokes, text, and small solids.
Do not use a second neon hue without a semantic reason (danger, warning).
antiPatterns: Rainbow neon gradients across a hero.
Dark-on-dark text at 2:1 because the glow looked nice.
